message.reasoning: The user wants to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker service. We can use the provided tool to execute a command. The command might be "net start com.docker.service" or "docker start". But "docker start" starts containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker daemon, we need "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service" in PowerShell. The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." That seems ambiguous. They might want to start Docker containers. But they say "start Docker on window using docker start." Possibly they want to start Docker service. Let's assume they want to start Docker service. We'll use the tool to run "net start com.docker.service".
